subject: english-language
title: Using Rhetoric in Your Own Writing Adventure
welcome_lead: Now apply the devices — building paragraphs and speeches that actually move people.
meta_desc: GCSE English Language rhetoric applied — AFOREST in action, anecdotes, stats and expert opinion.
final_note: You practised deploying AFOREST devices and combining them for maximum persuasive impact.

concepts.def: Brief personal story used as evidence
A number-based fact that boosts authority
Quoting an authority to lend weight

walkthroughs.body_html: Powerful speakers shift pronouns: 'I stand here today... we can change this... you must act.'

Open with a story: 'Last week, I met seven-year-old Aaliyah, sleeping in her family's car.'

Follow with a stat: 'She's one of 138,000 children homeless tonight.'

Story moves the heart, number proves the scale.
End with a punchy command: 'Sign the petition.' 'Write to your MP.' 'Do something — today.'
